_doc: Greenhouse Dome: grass beds, fence lines and brush. Fences stop bodies but not shots (Sneaky Pete ghosts through them, Chef Cerebro blinks over); brush hides whoever stands in it until a dash flattens it; Digby burrows under it all. Rects are [col, row, width, height] in 8 px cells on the 84x36 grid. The deathmatch pads (the side walls' middle) stay clear.
